title: VSift search data v1
description: The data member of a complete or partial search result: one bounded page of the transcript segments that match a literal query, in rank order (phrase matches first, then all-terms matches, each by segment start). items are the matching segments as published transcript evidence records (transcript-segment.schema.json), exactly as transcript.get returns them; hits names each item's segment_id and how it matched, in the same order. query.terms is how the query was normalised. range is the requested range, or null when the whole transcript was searched. transcript_coverage says which parts of the searched range a transcript covers: a word said in an untranscribed range cannot be found, and on-screen text is never searched. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json: its coverage member is truncated, and its status partial, exactly when untranscribed_ranges is not empty. Pass next_cursor back with the same session, query, range and revision to continue; it is rejected for any other search, session or revision, or after the session expires.

terms.description: The normalised query words, in query order: lowercase letters and digits, with a decimal point only between digits.

match.description: phrase: the query words joined without spaces equal consecutive segment words joined without spaces. all_terms: every query word is a segment word, in any order.

basis.description: supplied_transcript: a supplied SubRip or WebVTT file, taken to cover the whole source but not verified to be complete. local_asr: local speech recognition only; covered ranges are those it examined. mixed: local speech recognition of part of the source spliced into supplied text elsewhere.

scope.description: What search reads: transcript text only; on-screen text is not searched.

searched_range.description: The requested range (or the whole source) clipped to the source; null when the requested range lies wholly outside it.

no_speech_ranges.description: Transcribed ranges where local recognition found no audible signal or no audio; never overlapping a segment.

ranges_truncated.description: True when a range list held more than 100 ranges and only its first 100, in start order, are listed.
